name: Local Multi-Control — 本地多控 · 多角色冒险
author: liwenhao0427
description: Convert the online multiplayer flow into local multi-control: 2-12 switchable characters on one machine for solo / local co-op. 将联网多人流程改造为本地多角色可切换操控，支持单机多人协作。
tag: 本地多控 多角色 | Local Multi-Control
detail: Turns the online multiplayer flow into local multi-control: character switching, lobby multi-character editing, and control-context sync for combat / events / rest sites, plus stability fixes. Pure code, no extra assets. 将联网多角色流程转为本地多控：角色切换、大厅多角色编辑、战斗/事件/休息区等阶段的控制上下文同步与稳定性修复。纯代码实现，无额外素材依赖。
